scope: READ-ONLY current MAIN production integration audit. No Assets/main writes, Unity/native/UI operations, runtime implementation or broad architecture change. Plans below are not installed.

facts: Current Population instances retain original position/yaw/stable key and unit scale. Version1 remains installed; rejected vertical-seating candidate is not the root implementation.
Streaming uploads one shared Mesh per prototype/LOD, then releases decoded arrays. PageKey has model/LOD/page only and draw always uses submesh0.
All captured render batches swap together; CachedCell.Published changes only for captured cells still identical in the resident dictionary. Nearby movement readiness depends on that publication.
BlocksBody, WeightedSoftVoxels and TryGetSupportHeight read model.Data immutable hard/leaf/stick columns separately from draw batches; there is currently no instance root representation selector.
Default UseTreeImpostors=true substitutes billboard meshes at treeLOD3/4, and ForestHorizon is a separate path. Changing unused packed coarse meshLODs does not change far atlas roots.
Exploration controller explicitly owns no editing tools. Root gameplay/edit publication is not already supplied by Core.VoxelWorld.Set or the CPU cache.

Flight/capacity refinements already own terrain demand/scheduling. Root changes need no WorldExplorer/WorldExplorerVoxels planner, flight timer, movement speeds, source-resolution or terrain-cap edits.

smallest_coherent_boundary.scope: Initially only validated prototypeIDs10/11, preserving all population placement/stable keys, original shared fallback, impostors, horizon and AVPM4. Number of activated root instances must remain explicitly bounded; two-entry CPU proof is not forest-wide adoption.
smallest_coherent_boundary.one_owner: One small RootContactStreaming owner called by VegetationStreaming.Tick; retain cooperative single-worker semantics. A real background Task is optional later and needs immutable snapshots/thread tests, not prerequisite for the first integration.
smallest_coherent_boundary.shared_mesh_solution: Use the existing SharedUpperSplit approach BEFORE first Unity upload: ONE canonical vertex buffer, upper submesh0 and authored-base submesh1, with two appended vertices per uniform crossing quad. Do not retain another full or upper vertex buffer.
smallest_coherent_boundary.production_draw_rule: Fallback instance draws both canonical upper0 and authored-base1. Active grounded instance draws canonical upper0 plus its prepared lower mesh. Never globally zero submesh1 as the isolated native fixture does: that would alter every instance sharing the Mesh.
smallest_coherent_boundary.delta_accounting: Partition indices together cost original indices plus6 per crossing; appended vertices cost2 per crossing. With current28-byte uploaded vertices, GPU payload increase is80bytes/crossing. Split preparation adds temporary CPU index arrays and must yield/count preparation work before ReleaseMeshData.
smallest_coherent_boundary.lod_rule: Use only mechanically safe uniform-crossing cuts [30,32,36,60,124]. Derived lowerLOD must include canonical buffer/representatives up to its own cut while matter/collision ownership stays<=29. Independent composite lower proof now passes all5 LODs for both specimen10 and11. Cuts alone were not that proof; the new comparisons use actual canonical order/material/RGB.
smallest_coherent_boundary.billboard_rule: DefaultLOD3/4 stays canonical ForestBillboard and far ForestHorizon. Retain active exact root collision independently of drawLOD. No atlas rebake is authorized; distant visual root silhouette is explicitly unchanged. Validate transition/popping and mesh fallback with UseTreeImpostors=false separately.
smallest_coherent_boundary.wind_rule: All lower vertices must be expressed in the SAME original prototype-local coordinates and use the SAME instance matrix as the upper. A translated child/chunk matrix would change rootWS and height/phase in VoxelWind. Preserve material+AO packing, wind padding, motion/shadow passes. Native static-wind proof does not establish moving-wind continuity.

file_delta_plan.change: Promote reviewed CPU builders/interactions/cache with immutable identities, explicit counters/caps and producer-owned results. Keep WorldScaleData noEngineReferences. Do not modify generic Core tree generation or GroundCoverScatter.
file_delta_plan.gate: Existing CPU/netstandard suites plus actual sidecar/template validation; distinguish root geometry policy version from population placement version.

file_delta_plan.change: Add optional prototype template/split metadata; derive/load only supported records before ReleaseMeshData. Upload shared2-submesh canonical Mesh once; record per-submesh triangles. Pump one bounded root owner without moving or rewriting existing loading/cell/matrix scheduling.
file_delta_plan.gate: No new Ready shortcut or global hard-prop stall; failed/missing root template retains canonical rendering and collision.

file_delta_plan.change: Add SubmeshIndex and representation part to draw page/batch descriptors. Canonical upper pages may include both grounded/fallback instances; authored-base pages include fallback only; derived lower uses ready per-instance mesh. Capture binding/lease table with matrix snapshot and publish it at the SAME batches swap.
file_delta_plan.gate: Triangle cost is aggregate upper+actual lower or upper+authored base, not just one Model.Triangles entry. Retain current cheapest-coverage reservation and explicit demotion counters. Include every lower draw/shadow in stats/bounds.

file_delta_plan.change: Consult the SAME published per-instance binding as rendering. For active roots query new hard/stick spans below3m; preserve canonical upper spans at/above3m and canonical leaves. Never OR new lower hard spans with the complete old hard prototype, which would retain phantom authored roots.
file_delta_plan.gate: Atomic render/body/resistance/support fixture at row29/30, negative coordinates, yaw, under-body queries and updated minimumY bounds. Preserve existing conservative yaw handling and resistance normalization.

file_delta_plan.change: No reader/format change is necessary for the initial two templates if their validated zero-lower-leaf certificate is enforced. For future specimens with lower leaves, add a narrow immutable leaf-only resistance query or channel selector: current public ResistanceLocal mixes leaves and sticks, so clipping the whole lower query would remove canonical leaves. Reuse existing span math.
file_delta_plan.gate: Current captures certify zero canonical non-Wood lower/context candidates forIDs10/11 only. Unsupported templates retain canonical fallback; AVPM1..4 parsing remains unchanged.

file_delta_plan.change: Own controller, per-instance demand/bindings, bounded mesh preparation/upload stages and explicit native/CPU byte accounting. Prepare complete lower meshes for requiredLOD set plus exact role spans and conservative bounds; CPU cache completion is only an intermediate state.
file_delta_plan.gate: Do not expose a representation until CPU, meshes, roles, owner epoch and source/context/template identities agree. Keep old representation/resources alive until replaced render batches retire.

file_delta_plan.change: Rebase lower draw matrices/bounds together with active and next canonical batches. Cancel obsolete cell demand and uncommitted jobs; release only nonpublished/unpinned resources. Preserve current64m density and512m source safety guards and captured-cell identity checks.
file_delta_plan.gate: Travel, rebase, density, source-change and refresh tests must cover builds during matrix snapshots and old/new resource lifetime.

file_delta_plan.change: Prefer retaining existing single caller and RegionChanged hook. Pass full source snapshot/epoch context to the root owner through Population; do not add another Update loop or change movement/flight ownership.
file_delta_plan.gate: Preserve spawn clearing IsReady contract and LateUpdate order: live publication, wind origin, Population.SetObserver, Population.Tick.

file_delta_plan.change: Only if validated canonical lower data cannot be derived from retained existing authoring artifacts: export a SMALL sidecar forIDs10/11 from exact source generation/order, tied to current packSHA. Preserve full AVPM4/atlas bytes and interactions; do not rebake99models or introduce AVPM5.
file_delta_plan.gate: Canonical material/RGB and reducer representatives/ranks must compare to actual packed outputs. Existing Persistence2 sorts chunk keys and is insufficient as an order record by itself.

file_delta_plan.change: No required edit for this boundary. Same-Mesh submeshes remove the need for a new all-pass clipping shader. Keep active flight/coordinator changes untouched.
file_delta_plan.gate: If later evidence requires changes here, review them separately against fresh current-main hashes.

proposed_data_interfaces.RootTemplateSet: PrototypeId + packSHA + rootTemplateSHA + canonicalContextSHA + generator/reducer policy + original fine origin/phase + perLOD cuts + immutable fixed representatives and original chunk ranks. Owns bounded shared data only.
proposed_data_interfaces.RootInstanceOwner: PopulationKey + StableKey + PrototypeId + captured cell reference/epoch. Keep this lifetime identity separate from geometry cache identity; pose alone does not own a population instance.
proposed_data_interfaces.RootRequestIdentity: Original global pose/yaw/unit scale, complete template/context/reducer identity, terrain snapshot/source identity, root geometry and interaction policy; editRevision=0 until edit integration exists.
proposed_data_interfaces.RootTerrainSnapshot: Capture IWorldFieldSnapshotProvider when available (TerrainDetailField forwards it), wrap the captured bare field and unchanged SurfaceProfile. Sample global10cm cell centers; return VoxelTerrainPage.SurfaceTop(column.GroundHeightMeters), not renderedLOD/interpolated height or snow top.
proposed_data_interfaces.PreparedRootRepresentation: Complete lower Mesh array/LOD cuts + shared split layout identity + immutable hard/stick spans + actual bounds + perLOD triangles + CPU/native memory leases. Not a new prototype ID and not yet published.
proposed_data_interfaces.PublishedRootBinding: Immutable per-instance binding captured with nextBatches. Exactly one representation determines rendering and all gameplay queries. Keep old leases until old batches and associated collision snapshot are retired.

atomic_transaction: Admit demand only for supported prototypes with validated shared data. Keep canonical fallback as the currently published representation; no geometry/collision partial switch.
Capture immutable terrain/profile plus cell/template/context epochs. Build CPU geometry, roles and composite lowerLOD caches incrementally under independent pending/CPU/native byte caps.

Upload all selected lower meshes with the shared original-local origin, complete exact interaction spans and union bounds. Count upload work and native bytes separately from the CPU cache reservation.

Immediately before admission to next matrix snapshot and again before final swap, require current terrain validity AND template/context/reducer policy AND cell owner/epoch AND edit epoch. FrozenJob no longer independently checks after its interaction phase; full Current predicate is mandatory.

Do not change collision under the body. First activation occurs before local readiness admits player entry, or in a safe unloaded/far region; otherwise retain old published binding until a safe transaction is possible.
At existing batches/nextBatches swap, switch matching RootBinding map and CachedCell publication together. Never mark root data usable simply because CPU job completed.
Only then retire old mesh/spans/leases. Rebase affects render matrices and bounds only; physical pose/source identity never changes with floating origin.

freshness_and_edits.full_current_gate: Must cover terrain snapshot validity, upper context/template/pack/reducer revision, owner cell epoch, original pose and any future edit revision. Terrain-only Current is insufficient during packing/cache residency.
freshness_and_edits.global_revision_caveat: ExplorationRefinementField.SourceIdentity increments globally when a distant patch publishes. Do not make active near collision disappear merely because an unrelated far revision changed; current population deliberately retains near cells. Either explicitly invalidate uncommitted jobs globally while retaining old published snapshot safely, or use region-epoch validation over the complete sampling footprint. That footprint includes SurfaceMaterialSampler relief/climate queries (up to24m beyond sampled columns), not only the root X/Z box.
freshness_and_edits.initial_simple_policy: Conservative first integration can cancel/retry all uncommitted work on any global source change, retaining committed old mesh+collision together until normal safe cell replacement. Never call a stale CPU lease to reconstruct collision after commit; retain an explicitly owned published representation or safe local epoch lease. Full reset/template replacement invalidates all owner epochs.
freshness_and_edits.edit_boundary: Main Exploration has no prop editing path. Do not claim destructible root adoption. If edits are introduced later, materialize the published cells/roles with original provenance in authoritative VoxelWorld via Set, bump edit revision, cancel derivation, and rebuild render+collision transactionally; never regenerate over edits or silently return to canonical roots.

shared_template_residency.missing_canonical_data: Existing baseline.bin records Wood only, foliage suppressed, in original Wood chunk/cell traversal order. These small derived artifacts can serve the targeted companion-template boundary without rebaking AVPM4 or the atlas.
shared_template_residency.no_full_tree_runtime: Never retain/generate the entire fine redwood world per instance. Small immutable per-template fixed representative/rank data plus bounded<=65536 root cells is the intended dependency. Root/contact canonical context through32 is not sufficient for coarseLOD upper halo by itself.

fallback_policy: Missing/invalid/unsupported template, AVPM legacy lacking exact material, source/bounds/cliff/connectivity failure, queue-full, cache-full or native budget refusal keeps the existing complete canonical representation and its existing collision. Report reason and pending/retry status; no phantom invisible root or silently omitted tree.

Once a root is committed, temporary pressure cannot evict collision beneath the player. Retain/pin the published representation, use its already prepared coarser representation or explicit canonical billboard path, and defer new roots. Revert to canonical only via safe atomic render+collision transaction.

Keep original caps/coverage behavior. Do not raise32M triangle budget, weaken near readiness or remove pending jobs to disguise root costs. Root owner must separately cap shared templates, active prepared/published native lower meshes, uploads and queued CPU work.
